paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante ka piak, Kanan gam vaenkhe dingin mite sawl dih ve; a nam inko chih ua mi, a intekpapen lak ua mi khat chiat jel na sawl ding ahi, achia.
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

paite: Huan, Mosiin Paran gamdai akipanin TOUPA thupiak bangin a kuansakta chiat hi; a vek un Israel suante laka intekpapen chiat ahi uhi.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

paite: Hiaite a min uh ahi; Reuben nam laka mi Zakur tapa samu.
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

paite: Simeon nam laka mi Hori tapa Saphat.
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

paite: Juda nam laka mi jephune tapa Kaleb.
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Isakar nam laka mi Joseph tapa Igal.
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

paite: Ephraim nam laka mi Nun tapa Hose.
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

paite: Benjamin nam laka mi laka mi Raphu tapa Palti.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

paite: Aebulun nam laka mi Sodi tapa Gadiel.
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

paite: Joseph nam (Manase nam a chih uh) laka mi Susi tapa Gadi.
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

paite: Dan nam laka mi Gemali tapa Amiel.
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

paite: Aser nam laka mi kikael tapa Sethur.
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

paite: Naphtali nam laka mi Vopsi tapa Nabi.
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

paite: Gad nam laka mi Maki tapa Geuel.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

paite: Hiaite gam enkhe dinga Mosiin a sawlte min ahi. Nun tapa Hose Mosiin Josua a chi.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

paite: Huchiin Mosiin Kanan gam enkhe dingin amaute a sawla, a kiang uah, Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte khawng kahtou unla:
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country:

paite: Huai gam bangchi bang ahia chihte, huaia teng mipite a hat uh hia hatlou chih te a tawm uleh a tam te uh;
english: and see the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

paite: A omna gam uh a hoih hia hoihlou chihte, a omna khuate uh bangchi bang ahia, puanin maimah hia kulh nei chihte,
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

paite: Huan, huai gam lei hoih hia lei gawng, a gammang hia manglou chih te vaenkhia unla. Huan, hangsan takin om unla, mi gam theigahte honpua un, a chi a. Grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.”

paite: Huchiin a pawt touta ua, Huai gam Zin gamdai akipana Hamath lutna Rehob tanin a enkhe vek uh.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: Simlam ah a hohtou phot ua, Hebron a vatung ua, huailaiah Anak suan Ahinamte, Sesaite, Talmaite a om uh. (Hebron bel Aigupta gama Zoan kilam ma kum sagiha kilam khin ahi).
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

paite: Huan, Eskil guam a vatung ua, huaiah grep gah bawm khat ahiang toh a sat tan ua, chiangin mi nihin a jawng uh: pomgranet theite leh theipite leng pua uh.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

paite: Huailai bel Eskol guam a chi ua; Israel suanten huai akipan grep bawm a sat khiak jiak un.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

paite: Huan, gam a vaetkhiakna uah ni sawmli a tam ua, a hongnawnta uhi.
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

paite: Huchiin Paran gamdaia Kades ah Mosi leh Aron leh Israel suan mipi tengteng kiang a hongtung ua, a kiang uah leh mipi tengteng kiangah thu a hontun ua, huai gam theite a lak uhi.
english: They went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

paite: Huan, a kiangah, Na honsawlna gamah ka hoh ua, bawngnawitui leh khuaiju luanna a nahi ngeingut; hiai a gama thei ahi.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us; and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is its fruit.

paite: Himahleh a gama mi omte mi hat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulhnei, thupi taktak ahi: huan, Anak suante leng ka mu uhi.
english: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

paite: Amalekte Simlam gamah a gam ua; Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte, tanggam ahte a om uh: huan, Kanante bel tuipi gei leh Jordan lui dungah a om uh, chiin a hilh ua.
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill country; and the Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.”

paite: Huchiin Mosi maah Kalebin mipite a daisak khekhup a, Kisa tou zok ni, vala tou zok ni, I zou ngeingei ding uh, a chi a.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.”

paite: Himahleh a hohpihten, I vazou thei vek kei ding e, ei sangin lah a hat ngal ua, a chi ua.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

paite: Huchiin Israel suante kiangah a vagam etkhiak uh, Gam enkhe dinga ka vavakna uh, a sunga mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; huan, a mi om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.Huan, huaiah Anak suante, mi liante, awmkhauh pipi ka vamu u; khaupe bang lelin ka kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lelin a honmu uh, chiin a hoihlou lamin a gen uh.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

paite: Huan, huaiah Anak suante, mi liante, awmkhauh pipi ka vamu u; khaupe bang lelin ka kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lelin a honmu uh, chiin a hoihlou lamin a gen uh.
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”
